entities.summary: Alfred Bruce Morris is an American former professional football player who was a running back in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Florida Atlantic Owls and was selected by the Washington Redskins in the sixth round of the 2012 NFL draft. Morris also played for the San Francisco 49ers, Dallas Cowboys, Arizona Cardinals, and New York Giants.
